$comment: Starter dashboard for the PlayWithPro production project. Import with infra/posthog/README.md (PostHog API: POST /api/projects/:id/dashboards/ with this body's `tiles` translated to insights, or recreate by hand — the queries below are the source of truth).
name: PlayWithPro — launch readiness
description: Booking funnel, sessions by service, error rate by release. Internal users (property internal=true) are excluded via the project's internal-user filter.

tiles.name: Booking funnel
tiles.description: Web funnel steps (consent-gated) joined with API money events on the same person.

tiles.name: Money outcomes
tiles.description: API-emitted terminal events; refunds and disputes should stay a small share of completions.

tiles.name: Errors by release
tiles.description: Exception events split by the deploy SHA; a step after a deploy points at that release.

tiles.name: Consent accepted vs declined
tiles.description: Only accepted visitors send events; compare $pageview persons with server-side session_paid persons to estimate the declined share.
